address_pairs.notes: A surviving Black Hunter cries out to Im Yeongjun after Taekyung destroys his shoulder.
address_pairs.speaker: 블랙 헌터

continuity: Jin Taekyung killed numerous Black Hunters at Im Yeongjun's countryside mansion and drove the survivors inside.
Im Yeongjun confirmed that the assault on Im Kkeokjeong was an order from an unnamed authority above him.
Im Yeongjun threatened Taekyung's mother and younger sister and offered to arrange his life as a compensated civilian instead of an A-rank Hunter.
Taekyung rejected all compromise, deciding to answer the Black Hunters according to the way of Murim.
Taekyung defeated Im Yeongjun in three exchanges and destroyed one of his shoulders with the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist.
Taekyung destroyed the mansion's powerful layered defensive barriers and severely damaged the mansion with the Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist.
Im Yeongjun survived the initial assault and remained inside the ruined mansion with surviving Black Hunters when Taekyung confronted him.
plot: Jin Taekyung slaughtered the Black Hunters surrounding Im Yeongjun, quickly killing several of them while confirming that his first target was not one of Im Kkeokjeong's three attackers. Im Yeongjun revealed that the attack on Kkeokjeong had been an order from above and offered to negotiate Taekyung's retirement as an A-rank Hunter, threatening his mother and younger sister when Taekyung refused. Taekyung rejected the offer and chose the way of Murim over compromise.

Taekyung continued cutting through the Black Hunters, including their tanks, mages, melee fighters, and archers. He defeated Im Yeongjun in three exchanges, destroying his shoulder with the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist, then pursued him into the mansion and shattered its layered defensive barriers with the Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist. With Im Yeongjun and the surviving Black Hunters trapped inside the ruined mansion, Taekyung declared himself a monster like them and asked whether Im knew the Tendon-Splitting and Bone-Twisting technique.
translation_decisions: Render 멸천신권 as Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist, distinct from 멸염신권, rendered Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist.
Render 삼성의 공력 in this context as three-tenths of internal energy, not Three Saints.
Retain the stepping-stone metaphor in Im Yeongjun's proposed negotiation and Taekyung's rejection.
Preserve Taekyung's graphic, dryly mocking first-person voice during the massacre.

active_continuity: Butler Kim traced the Black Hunter “tail” to Im Yeongjun, a Level 95 A-rank Hunter living under the identity of a wealthy rural resident.
The group suspects Im Yeongjun's biweekly village feasts conceal the supply chain for a Black Hunter training operation.
Twenty-eight Black Hunters were present or hiding at Im Yeongjun's mansion, including the three attackers who severed Im Kkeokjeong's arms.
Taekyung entered the protected mansion alone after deciding that human opponents trained to hunt people were within his specialty.
Im Yeongjun ordered the Black Hunters to kill Taekyung after Taekyung demanded the three attackers be surrendered and the rest disarm.
Taekyung fought the Black Hunters with White Flame, Spear Energy, internal energy, and copied martial techniques.
Taekyung killed numerous Black Hunters and forced the survivors to retreat into the mansion.
Im Yeongjun said the attack on Im Kkeokjeong was an order from an unnamed authority above him.
Im Yeongjun threatened Taekyung's mother and younger sister and offered to arrange his retirement as a compensated civilian.
Taekyung rejected compromise and chose the way of Murim over the modern approach.
Taekyung destroyed Im Yeongjun's shoulder with the Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist and pursued him into the mansion.
Taekyung destroyed the mansion's layered defensive barriers and severely damaged the building with the Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist.
Taekyung confronted the surviving Im Yeongjun inside the ruined mansion and invoked Tendon-Splitting and Bone-Twisting.
open_questions: Which major Guild or powerful authority is backing Im Yeongjun and the Black Hunter operation?
Were the village feasts actually being used to procure supplies for the Black Hunter training operation?
What information will Im Yeongjun reveal after Taekyung begins questioning him?
temporary_decisions: Render 세 얼간이 as the Three Idiots.
Render 도사견 as Tosa dogs and 보신탕 as dog-meat soup.
Render 수강 as qi condensed around the hand.
Render 멸천신권 as Heaven-Destroying Divine Fist, distinct from 멸염신권 as Flame-Extinguishing Divine Fist.
Render 삼성의 공력 as three-tenths of internal energy in this chapter's context.

names.notes: Taekyung's full-power fist technique used to destroy the mansion's defensive barriers; distinct from 멸염신권.
